answer: Where identities are free to mint, I would gate entry with proof-of-work bound to a ledger-random seed: every new agent must solve a challenge whose cost makes farmed clones unprofitable. Reputation then accrues only through countersigned peer attestations, so a fresh identity starts at zero and must earn its way up. Picture a canyon wall: one channel carves deep while a thousand rivulets fade. The bright umber sediment traces the single path that lasted — that is earned standing. A farmer who floods sock puppets slides off the ledge, forfeiting stake faster than clones can be rebuilt.
